Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.mapping

Class DcatMapper

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.mapping.DcatMappingBase
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.mapping.DcatMapper
public class DcatMapper extends DcatMappingBase
DcatMapper catalogs the resources described in a DCAT document as open metadata elements. Each resource is matched to an existing element through a qualified name built from the resource's IRI (or its identifier or title if it has no IRI), so sending the same description again updates the elements rather than creating new ones.
